bio: Hi there, I am Ariji or Percy. I'm a senior CS student at Drexel and an undergraduate researcher with ViLab and DIVA Lab, advised by Professor Feng Liu and Professor Tiffany D. Do, respectively.

My research sits at the intersection of generative AI, including diffusion models, LLMs, and VLMs, and human-computer interaction. I am especially interested in how agentic systems can be grounded in spatial, pedagogical, robotic, and digital AR/VR contexts.

I am also a long-time developer with experience across full-stack engineering, forward deployed engineering, AI/LLM engineering, and product engineering. I have participated in 20+ hackathons at universities including MIT, Stanford, Princeton, and others, winning 7+ awards so far.
I am always trying to live a meaningful, happy, and productive life, and I am always looking to make new friends. Feel free to reach out through any of the links here.

publication.venue: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education
publication.title: DrawSim-PD: Simulating Student Science Drawings to Support NGSS-Aligned Teacher Diagnostic Reasoning
publication.abstract: A generative framework that simulates student-like science drawings, reasoning narratives, and diagnostic concept maps with realistic misconceptions to help K-12 teachers practice and improve their diagnostic reasoning skills.
highlights: Simulates 10,000+ multimodal student science drawings across 100 NGSS curriculum standards.
Synthesizes first-person student reasoning narratives and diagnostic concept maps.
Designed & evaluated to calibrate K-12 educator visual diagnostic reasoning.
